messages.subject: blavaan ERROR: problem with translation from lavaan to jags
parts:
Hi Ed, 
I was wondering if you had any thoughts about why this error might be occurring. I only have 209 obs, and some variables have 52% of missing data. I am trying to fit a growth curve model for 3 times. 

Here is the syntax that I am using, just in case:

Curva_difus<-'

df9=~D1*DfSt_09+D2*DfIntp_09

df10=~D1*DfSt_10+D2*DfIntp_10

df11=~D1*DfSt_11+D2*DfIntp_11

 

DfSt_09 ~~ DfSt_10 + DfSt_11

DfSt_10 ~~ DfSt_11

 

DfIntp_09 ~~ DfIntp_10 + DfIntp_11

DfIntp_10 ~~ DfIntp_11

 

df9~~1*df9

df10~~NA*df10

df11~~NA*df11

 

## medias

df9 ~ 0*1

df10 ~ NA*1

df11 ~ NA*1

 

#Intecepts

DfSt_09 ~tm1*1

DfIntp_09 ~tm2*1

 

DfSt_10~tm1*1

DfIntp_10 ~tm2*1

 

DfSt_11~tm1*1

DfIntp_11 ~tm2*1


#Curva parameters

Int_dif=~1*df9+1*df10+1*df11

Slp_dif=~0*df9+1*df10+2*df11
'
AC_difus<-bgrowth(Curva_difus, data=parcelas)

Thanks, 

Diego

messages.subject: Re: blavaan ERROR: problem with translation from lavaan to jags
parts:
Hi Diego,

I doubt that the missing data or sample size is causing this; it is more likely to be something in the syntax that blavaan doesn't understand. Two questions:

1. Can you successfully estimate the model using lavaan's growth() function?

2. Can you provide a data set for me to try out? (even if it is fake data)

Ed

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: blavaan ERROR: problem with translation from lavaan to jags
parts:
Diego,

Thanks for the model and data. I can replicate the bgrowth error, and it will take me some time to track down why it happens for this model.

In the meantime, you might look at lavaan again. It looks like growth() is automatically fixing the D1 loadings to 1, and I'm not sure that this is desired. But, when D1 is fixed to 1, it seems like you might have success with changing the equality constraint on the "df9" variance to be smaller:

df9 ~~ .1*df9

Ed

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: blavaan ERROR: problem with translation from lavaan to jags
parts:
Hi Diego,

I have made some changes to blavaan to handle growth models, now incorporated into github and the devel version. I suspect there is still an indeterminacy in your model because the chains are not converging (i.e., the same problem might be leading to the non-positive definite cov matrix in lavaan and non-convergence in blavaan). I have not found the problem and will look some more when I get some time.

Ed
